verdict.rationale: Cursor ships an official CLI (cursor.com/cli) and docs describe scheduled/triggered 'always-on agents' and parallel background agent fleets, implying some non-interactive/automation capability, but the evidence pack never documents concrete script-mode flags, exit codes, or CI/CD scripting examples for headless agent runs. missing for 10: explicit CLI non-interactive/headless flag documentation, CI pipeline usage examples, and independent confirmation that scripted invocation works reliably.
